rules.source: Eric approved the cockpit T30 narrow presentation repair with unchanged text, fields, font and areas, work order 2026-11-24 PR B.
rules.rule: Give the original creator, paired PO identity, dates and signed difference enough room to wrap within their group.
rules.initialization: Use the original Astryx-scoped cockpit styles. No schema or navigation data change; the existing narrow PO and flow horizontal scrollers still own their content.
rules.dateAndPermission: Keep actual, target, scope, sign and font sizes. Only the affected detail cells and date grouping receive narrower wrapping.
rules.expectation: Signed native browser with actual two-PO adoption and a lengthened TEST creator verifies 1165, 650 and 360 pixel text bounds, stable full dates and signed values.

rules.source: Eric approved G14 returning keyboard focus to the original filtered overview row or list if the row has disappeared, work order 2026-11-24 PR B.
rules.rule: Focus the matching order once its current overview response is applied and leave existing reading/scroll restoration in charge of position.
rules.initialization: Keep a per-navigation focus target in the current component only; no persistent storage or additional API call.
rules.dateAndPermission: Tie the target to the exact identity and applied filter. A focus already moved elsewhere stays there. Focus restoration never scrolls a different order into view.
rules.expectation: Enter on a real filtered row, then Enter on the original return action, while the list response is held. The same visible row is focused before Tab; an intentionally missing row falls back to its original list and the return makes exactly the existing one request.

checks.context: Canonical two-worker isolated Acceptance PostgreSQL and Chromium, signed original App. Original A/B, dual PO scope, accepted field set, filtered return and the three narrow viewports exercised.

checks.command: npm run typecheck; scoped ESLint; node scripts/acceptance/time-site-inventory.mjs; git diff --check
checks.context: Repository Node 22 and npm 10. No deployment, database configuration, platform gate or framework change.
